figures.note: Mobile phone items are detected by a keyword match on item titles (phone, smartphone, iphone, telephone); this heuristic is not an official list.

figures.label: Time limit to claim (professional shipper, France)
figures.note: 14 days apply to consumer shippers, which is not our case. Counted in calendar days, which is never later than the real deadline.

figures.label: Reserve window after delivery
figures.note: Same 3-day window as the claim. The clause asking for written reserves on the delivery slip comes from the research notes of 2026-10-22 and was not re-read.

notes: Figures are for the public professional terms; a negotiated contract may differ (not public). UNVERIFIED for those merchants.
Without detailed written reserves on the delivery slip, the claimant must prove that the damage comes from transport; photos taken at delivery matter.
Insufficient packaging and the shipper's own fault are excluded; the optional insurance (up to 5000 EUR) is not modelled and the order does not say whether it was bought.
Claims are filed by the merchant through the online customer service form or live chat; no claim API was found. The shipping fee must have been paid.
